Nasiruddin Sk vs Unknown on 9 June, 2023
09.06.2023
Item no. 27
Ct.29
(Suvendu)
 C.R.M. (A) No.2190 of 2023

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438
 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Katwa
 Police Station Case No.358 of 2023 dated 24.04.2023 under
Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

And
 In the matter of:- Nasiruddin Sk.
 ....... Petitioner
 Mr. Manas Kumar Das
 Mr. Pritam Kumar Thakdar
 .. for the petitioner
 Mr. Imran Ali
 Ms. Sutapa Banerjee
 ..for the State
 1.
Heard learned Counsel appearing for the parties.
2. The petitioner is the husband of the victim.
Charge-sheet is stated to have been filed in the meantime.

3. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation, question of parity, materials placed before the Court by the parties and non-requirement of custodial interrogation in view of filing of charge-sheet, it is directed that the petitioner shall appear before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Katwa, District -Purba Bardhaman, in connection with GR Case arising out of Katwa Police Station Case No. 358 of 2023 within 15 days from today.
